verses.1: God be merciful unto us, and bless us, And cause his face to shine upon us; [Selah
verses.2: That thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.
verses.3: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.
verses.4: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And govern the nations upon earth. [Selah
verses.5: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.
verses.6: The earth hath yielded its increase: God, even our own God, will bless us.
verses.7: God will bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
